g3-implement.title: F12 falsifiable gate (held-out-circuit stability): implement
g3-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md for Gate 3 per CONVERGED_PLAN.md Gate 3 (critic disposition #3 baked in -- multi-split, not single-split). New src/physics/layer2/mixture_stability.py: hungarian_match(means_a, means_b) via scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment; component_agreement_stat(fit_a, fit_b) -> float (mean Euclidean distance between Hungarian-matched STANDARDIZED component means); F12_AGREEMENT_THRESHOLD pre-registered as a named constant, chosen and frozen BEFORE the real-data run (state the chosen value + one-line rationale in the module docstring); check_holdout_stability(df, n_splits=5, seed=42) -> StabilityResult running 5 independent deterministic seeded circuit-level splits (split by gp_name, non-overlapping halves each split) of the grip_bin_obs-derived descriptor set, fitting property_mixture.fit_property_mixture (Gate 2) independently on each half per split, computing component_agreement_stat per split, and returning the full distribution (per-split statistic, mean, range, count PASS/FAIL against F12_AGREEMENT_THRESHOLD) plus a single headline verdict. MANDATORY test: a DISCRIMINATING unit test -- two synthetic descriptor sets drawn from the SAME generator must PASS (statistic below threshold), two sets from deliberately shifted generators must FAIL (statistic above threshold) -- this proves the check can actually distinguish stable from unstable, not merely execute; a check that can only ever pass is not falsifiable in practice. Then run check_holdout_stability against the REAL data/damage_integrals.db (absolute path C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/damage_integrals.db, read-only) via a script (scripts/f12_held_out_stability.py) and record the verdict -- PASS or FAIL, either closes the gate (Honest-Null Clause: a FAIL is a complete, reportable finding, not a blocker) -- write the full result to .agent-work/625-segmentation-substrate/artifacts/f12_holdout_stability.json. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
